goal: Make native Assurance Review reliably finish within one auditable 300-second total budget, with a bounded immutable-bundle prompt and exactly one terminal outcome, so near-complete reviewers are not repeatedly timed out without weakening reviewer authority or adding automatic retries.

acceptance.assertion: Every native Review operation uses one 300-second total deadline measured from initial dispatch, retains the existing 5-second spawn sub-budget and 12-turn cap, and projects the same deadline through advance results, Footer, Widget, timeout notification, and correlated terminal follow-up.

The native Review prompt requires immutable-bundle provenance first, limits analysis to acceptance assertions and immutable dirty-file contents, discourages unrelated repository exploration, reserves the final turn for exactly one strict JSON verdict, and still spawns with maxTurns 12.

Completion before timeout, timeout before completion, same-tick completion/timeout, explicit cancellation, and late terminal settlement each produce at most one winning terminal lifecycle and one correlated follow-up; timeout/cancel/partial/late output creates no pending verdict or Kernel write, and duplicate advance never spawns a second reviewer while ownership is unsettled.

Source and packaged Review dispatch contracts document the 300-second bounded ceiling, no automatic retry, one reviewer per immutable snapshot, settlement ownership, and unavailable fine-grained telemetry truthfully; all repository tests and generated-doc synchronization remain clean with no active 180-second Review contract.
